principles: Reuse existing lifecycle truth sources instead of duplicating gate logic.
Keep V1 read-only under success and failure paths.
Make blocker output actionable for the host.
drivers: Reduce host time spent diagnosing lifecycle blockers.
Keep the first implementation slice small enough to review.

options.name: A: Add focused lifecycle_check command backed by a StoryReadinessReport assembler
pros: Easy to smoke test for no mutation

options.name: B: Add broader story_pipeline wrapper now
cons: Risks duplicating done_prepare and phase gates

chosen: A: Add focused lifecycle_check command backed by a StoryReadinessReport assembler
rationale: Choose the narrow read-only report because it delivers the immediate host diagnostic value while preserving existing lifecycle gates and avoiding premature orchestration.

preMortem.trigger: Assembler calls existing mutating handlers instead of readers
preMortem.consequence: V1 violates proof-or-stop boundary and could stale evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Use direct readers and smoke-test before/after file snapshots

preMortem.scenario: Report computes DONE readiness differently from DONE gate
preMortem.trigger: Implementation reimplements gate logic instead of consuming existing oracle rows
preMortem.mitigation: Reuse done-oracle summaries where possible and label source rows

preMortem.scenario: Manual or external rows hide missing commands
preMortem.trigger: Rendering collapses all blockers into generic not-ready text
preMortem.consequence: Host still has to inspect scattered artifacts manually
preMortem.mitigation: Each blocking row carries source/category/code/owner/next action
